versos.grego: Παῦλος δοῦλος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, κλητὸς ἀπόστολος ἀφωρισμένος εἰς εὐαγγέλιον Θεοῦ,

controles.web: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,
controles.kjv: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
controles.livre: Paulo, servo de Cristo Jesus, chamado para ser apóstolo, separado para o evangelho de Deus,

versos.grego: ὃ προεπηγγείλατο διὰ τῶν προφητῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν γραφαῖς ἁγίαις

controles.web: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
controles.kjv: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
controles.livre: que antes havia prometido por meio dos seus profetas nas santas Escrituras,

versos.grego: περὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ τοῦ γενομένου ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυεὶδ κατὰ σάρκα,

controles.web: concerning his Son, who was born of the seed of David according to the flesh,
controles.kjv: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
controles.livre: acerca do seu Filho (que, quanto à carne, nasceu da descendência  de Davi,

versos.grego: τοῦ ὁρισθέντος Υἱοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν δυνάμει κατὰ πνεῦμα ἁγιωσύνης ἐξ ἀναστάσεως νεκρῶν, Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν,

controles.web: who was declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
controles.kjv: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
controles.livre: e declarado Filho de Deus em poder, segundo o Espírito de santidade, pela ressurreição dos mortos): Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor.

versos.grego: δι’ οὗ ἐλάβομεν χάριν καὶ ἀποστολὴν εἰς ὑπακοὴν πίστεως ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: through whom we received grace and apostleship, for obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name’s sake;
controles.kjv: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
controles.livre: Por ele recebemos graça e apostolado, para a obediência da fé entre todas as nações,  por causa do seu nome.

versos.grego: ἐν οἷς ἐστε καὶ ὑμεῖς κλητοὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;
controles.kjv: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
controles.livre: Entre elas sois também vós, chamados para serdes de Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: πᾶσιν τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Ῥώμῃ ἀγαπητοῖς Θεοῦ, κλητοῖς ἁγίοις· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: A todos que estais em Roma, amados de Deus, e chamados de santos:  convosco haja graça e paz da parte de Deus, nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Πρῶτον μὲν εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ μου διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν, ὅτι ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν καταγγέλλεται ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ κόσμῳ.

controles.web: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
controles.kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
controles.livre: Em primeiro lugar, agradeço ao meu Deus por meio de Jesus Cristo, por todos vós, porque a vossa fé é anunciada no mundo todo.

versos.grego: μάρτυς γάρ μού ἐστιν ὁ Θεός, ᾧ λατρεύω ἐν τῷ πνεύματί μου ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ, ὡς ἀδιαλείπτως μνείαν ὑμῶν ποιοῦμαι

controles.web: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
controles.kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
controles.livre: Pois Deus, a quem sirvo em meu espírito no evangelho do seu Filho, é minha testemunha de como sem cessar faço menção de vós,

versos.grego: πάντοτε ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου, δεόμενος εἴ πως ἤδη ποτὲ εὐοδωθήσομαι ἐν τῷ θελήματι τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
controles.kjv: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
controles.livre: rogando sempre em minhas orações, que agora, de alguma maneira, finalmente, tenha eu a oportunidade de, pela vontade de Deus, vir vos visitar.

versos.grego: ἐπιποθῶ γὰρ ἰδεῖν ὑμᾶς, ἵνα τι μεταδῶ χάρισμα ὑμῖν πνευματικὸν εἰς τὸ στηριχθῆναι ὑμᾶς,

controles.web: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
controles.kjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
controles.livre: Pois eu desejo ver-vos, para compartilhar convosco algum dom espiritual, para que sejais fortalecidos;

versos.grego: τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν συνπαρακληθῆναι ἐν ὑμῖν διὰ τῆς ἐν ἀλλήλοις πίστεως ὑμῶν τε καὶ ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
controles.kjv: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
controles.livre: isto é, para eu ser consolado juntamente convosco pela fé mútua, tanto a vossa, como a minha.

versos.grego: οὐ θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι πολλάκις προεθέμην ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἐκωλύθην ἄχρι τοῦ δεῦρο, ἵνα τινὰ καρπὸν σχῶ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν καθὼς καὶ ἐν τοῖς λοιποῖς ἔθνεσιν.

controles.web: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you, and was hindered so far, that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.
controles.kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
controles.livre: Porém, irmãos, não quero que ignoreis que muitas vezes pretendi vir à vossa presença (mas fui impedido até agora), a fim de que eu também tivesse algum fruto entre vós, como também entre os demais gentios.

versos.grego: Ἕλλησίν τε καὶ Βαρβάροις, σοφοῖς τε καὶ ἀνοήτοις ὀφειλέτης εἰμί·

controles.web: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
controles.kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
controles.livre: Eu sou devedor, tanto a gregos como a bárbaros, tanto a sábios como a não sábios.

versos.grego: οὕτως τὸ κατ’ ἐμὲ πρόθυμον καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς ἐν Ῥώμῃ εὐαγγελίσασθαι.

controles.web: So, as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
controles.kjv: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
controles.livre: Portanto, quanto a mim, pronto estou para anunciar o evangelho também a vós, que estais em Roma.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ἐπαισχύνομαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον· δύναμις γὰρ Θεοῦ ἐστιν εἰς σωτηρίαν παντὶ τῷ πιστεύοντι, Ἰουδαίῳ τε πρῶτον καὶ Ἕλληνι.

controles.web: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, for it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes; for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
controles.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
controles.livre: Porque não me envergonho do Evangelho,  pois é o poder de Deus para a salvação de todo aquele que crê, primeiramente do judeu, e também do grego.

versos.grego: δικαιοσύνη γὰρ Θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ ἀποκαλύπτεται ἐκ πίστεως εἰς πίστιν, καθὼς γέγραπται Ὁ δὲ δίκαιος ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται.

controles.web: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
controles.kjv: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
controles.livre: Pois no Evangelho  se revela a justiça de Deus de fé em fé; como está escrito: O justo viverá pela fé.

versos.grego: Ἀποκαλύπτεται γὰρ ὀργὴ Θεοῦ ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ἀσέβειαν καὶ ἀδικίαν ἀνθρώπων τῶν τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἐν ἀδικίᾳ κατεχόντων,

controles.web: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
controles.kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
controles.livre: Porque a ira de Deus se manifesta do céu contra toda irreverência e injustiça das pessoas que bloqueiam a verdade pela injustiça;

versos.grego: διότι τὸ γνωστὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ φανερόν ἐστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς· ὁ Θεὸς γὰρ αὐτοῖς ἐφανέρωσεν.

controles.web: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.
controles.kjv: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
controles.livre: pois o que se pode conhecer de Deus é evidente a eles, porque Deus lhes manifestou.

versos.grego: τὰ γὰρ ἀόρατα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ κτίσεως κόσμου τοῖς ποιήμασιν νοούμενα καθορᾶται, ἥ τε ἀΐδιος αὐτοῦ δύναμις καὶ θειότης, εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἀναπολογήτους,

controles.web: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse.
controles.kjv: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
controles.livre: Pois as suas características invisíveis, inclusive o seu eterno poder e divindade, desde a criação do mundo são entendidas e claramente vistas por meio das coisas criadas, para que não tenham desculpa;

versos.grego: διότι γνόντες τὸν Θεὸν οὐχ ὡς Θεὸν ἐδόξασαν ἢ ηὐχαρίστησαν, ἀλλὰ ἐματαιώθησαν ἐν τοῖς διαλογισμοῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐσκοτίσθη ἡ ἀσύνετος αὐτῶν καρδία.

controles.web: Because, knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, neither gave thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.
controles.kjv: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
controles.livre: Porque, ainda que tenham conhecido Deus, não o glorificaram como Deus, nem foram gratos; em vez disso, perderam o bom senso em seus pensamentos,  e seus tolos corações ficaram em trevas.

versos.grego: φάσκοντες εἶναι σοφοὶ ἐμωράνθησαν,

controles.web: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
controles.kjv: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
controles.livre: Chamando a si mesmos de sábios, tornaram-se tolos,

versos.grego: καὶ ἤλλαξαν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ ἀφθάρτου Θεοῦ ἐν ὁμοιώματι εἰκόνος φθαρτοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πετεινῶν καὶ τετραπόδων καὶ ἑρπετῶν.

controles.web: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed animals, and creeping things.
controles.kjv: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
controles.livre: e trocaram a glória de Deus indestrutível por semelhança de imagem do ser humano destrutível, e de aves, de quadrúpedes, e de répteis.

versos.grego: Διὸ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῶν καρδιῶν αὐτῶν εἰς ἀκαθαρσίαν τοῦ ἀτιμάζεσθαι τὰ σώματα αὐτῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς,

controles.web: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves,
controles.kjv: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
controles.livre: Por isso, Deus os entregou à imundície, nos desejos dos seus corações, para desonrarem os seus corpos entre si.

versos.grego: οἵτινες μετήλλαξαν τὴν ἀλήθειαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῷ ψεύδει, καὶ ἐσεβάσθησαν καὶ ἐλάτρευσαν τῇ κτίσει παρὰ τὸν Κτίσαντα, ὅς ἐστιν εὐλογητὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας· ἀμήν.

controles.web: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
controles.kjv: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
controles.livre: Trocaram a verdade de Deus pela mentira, e adoraram e serviram à criatura mais do que ao Criador, que é bendito eternamente, Amém!

versos.grego: Διὰ τοῦτο παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς ὁ Θεὸς εἰς πάθη ἀτιμίας· αἵ τε γὰρ θήλειαι αὐτῶν μετήλλαξαν τὴν φυσικὴν χρῆσιν εἰς τὴν παρὰ φύσιν,

controles.web: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.
controles.kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
controles.livre: Por isso, Deus os entregou a paixões infames. Pois até suas mulheres trocaram o hábito sexual natural pelo que era contra a natureza;

versos.grego: ὁμοίως τε καὶ οἱ ἄρσενες ἀφέντες τὴν φυσικὴν χρῆσιν τῆς θηλείας ἐξεκαύθησαν ἐν τῇ ὀρέξει αὐτῶν εἰς ἀλλήλους, ἄρσενες ἐν ἄρσεσιν τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην κατεργαζόμενοι καὶ τὴν ἀντιμισθίαν ἣν ἔδει τῆς πλάνης αὐτῶν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἀπολαμβάνοντες.

controles.web: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
controles.kjv: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
controles.livre: e também, de semelhante maneira, os machos abandonaram o hábito sexual natural com a mulher, e acenderam sua sensualidade uns com os outros, homens com homens, praticando indecência, e recebendo em si mesmos a devida retribuição pelo seu erro.

versos.grego: Καὶ καθὼς οὐκ ἐδοκίμασαν τὸν Θεὸν ἔχειν ἐν ἐπιγνώσει, παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς ὁ Θεὸς εἰς ἀδόκιμον νοῦν, ποιεῖν τὰ μὴ καθήκοντα,

controles.web: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
controles.kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
controles.livre: E como recusaram reconhecer a Deus, o mesmo Deus os entregou a uma mente corrompida, para fazerem coisas impróprias.

versos.grego: πεπληρωμένους πάσῃ ἀδικίᾳ πονηρίᾳ πλεονεξίᾳ κακίᾳ, μεστοὺς φθόνου φόνου ἔριδος δόλου κακοηθείας, ψιθυριστάς,

controles.web: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
controles.kjv: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
controles.livre: Assim, estão cheios de toda injustiça,  malícia, ganância, maldade; estão repletos de inveja, homicídio, brigas, engano, malignidade;

versos.grego: καταλάλους, θεοστυγεῖς, ὑβριστάς, ὑπερηφάνους, ἀλαζόνας, ἐφευρετὰς κακῶν, γονεῦσιν ἀπειθεῖς,

controles.web: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
controles.kjv: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
controles.livre: são murmuradores, difamadores, e odeiam a Deus; são insolentes, soberbos, presunçosos, inventores de males, e desobedientes aos pais;

versos.grego: ἀσυνέτους, ἀσυνθέτους, ἀστόργους, ἀνελεήμονας·

controles.web: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;
controles.kjv: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
controles.livre: não têm entendimento, quebram acordos, são insensíveis, e recusam-se a mostrar misericórdia.

versos.grego: οἵτινες τὸ δικαίωμα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπιγνόντες, ὅτι οἱ τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντες ἄξιοι θανάτου εἰσίν, οὐ μόνον αὐτὰ ποιοῦσιν, ἀλλὰ καὶ συνευδοκοῦσιν τοῖς πράσσουσιν.

controles.web: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
controles.kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
controles.livre: Apesar de conhecerem o juízo de Deus (de que os que fazem tais coisas merecem a morte), não somente as fazem, como também aprovam os que as praticam.
